Weather Analysis

Clear, dry day with strong diurnal temperature variation (17.1–33.9 °C). Moderate to fresh westerly winds (avg 10.5 km/h, max 23.2 km/h) with peak gusts to 41.4 km/h in the afternoon. UV index peaks at 6.65 midday under cloud-free conditions. No precipitation recorded.

Outdoor Activity Suggestion

  • Running/Biking: Optimal window 07:00–09:00 (18–22 °C, light winds, UV <2.6). Avoid 14:00–18:00 due to high heat (32–34 °C) and gusty winds.

Keine Niederschläge gemessen.

Vorschlag für Outdoor-Aktivitäten

  • Laufen/Radfahren: Optimales Zeitfenster 07:00–09:00 (18–22 °C, leichte Winde, UV <2,6). 14:00–18:00 meiden wegen hoher Hitze (32–34 °C) und böigen Winden.
